blocks.title: FCL vs LCL Shipping Comparison
paragraphs: Updated April 2026 | Container Shipping to Kenya
You rent an entire container exclusively for your cargo.
Your cargo shares a container with other shippers.
1. Calculate your cargo volume in CBM

2. Is volume > 15-20 CBM? 
→ YES: Get FCL quotes
→ NO: Compare FCL vs LCL costs

3. Is cargo high-value or time-sensitive? 
→ YES: Choose FCL regardless of volume
4. Get quotes for both and compare total landed costs
Get instant shipping quotes at kenyatradex.africa/ocean-freight.html
items: FCL (Full Container Load): You rent an entire container exclusively for your cargo.
LCL (Less than Container Load): Your cargo shares a container with other shippers.
